title: driver-sql / plugin-security: read the list-comparand operator split from @objectstack/spec/data (isListComparandOperator) instead of local LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS copies (#29419 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWR3K3h7i1ytwycVg1

Filing-gate category: ① a follow-up owed by landed work (PR #29570, #29419), filed under 「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」. ACCEPT 6586400840 item 5(b) on PR #29570 records it as the seat's to file.

## Location

Two modules still keep a hand copy of the list-comparand operator set:

- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` ≈L2581: `const LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS = new Set(['$in', '$nin', '$between'])`
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/rls-check-stored-form.ts` ≈L189: the same set, beside `VALUE_COMPARISON_OPERATORS`

Since PR #29570, `@objectstack/spec/data` exports `isListComparandOperator(op)` as the one source. Both copies equal the spec set today, so nothing is broken today.

## Business reason

#29419 removed the flow executor's copy for exactly this reason. When the spec's list operators change, a hand copy silently diverges. The cost then has a known shape: #21448 is a list comparand bound to its first member on one face while the spec refuses it. Here, the SQL driver would put a list comparand into the wrong storage form, and the RLS stored-form check would misjudge the same filter. Nothing would fail loudly. Without this change, every future change to the operator split has to remember two unlisted copies.

## Reader

domain:server seat, in one PR. Swap both local sets for `isListComparandOperator` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, following the import swap PR #29570 made in `service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts`. Delete any test that only reconciles a copy against the spec. Ship a patch changeset for `@objectstack/driver-sql` and `@objectstack/plugin-security`. No spec change.

Suggested priority: p3. This is a drift guard with no user-visible cost today.

## Duplicate check

Searched `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` (3 hits, all closed: #29419, which is the parent and covered the executor only; #21448; #9228) and `isListComparandOperator driver-sql` (1 hit: #29419). None tracks these two copies.
